mcts-default.description: MCTS-only mode using LLMMCTSCompressor — no trainable neural compressor weights
mcts-default.notes: Default MCTS baseline. Uses react_mcts.yaml MCTS config. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY.

raw-default.description: No compression — full trajectory appended verbatim at every step
raw-default.notes: Baseline 1. Use with react_baseline_raw.yaml agent config.

llm-summary-default.description: LLM-based trajectory summarization — frozen LLM call replaces compressed state
llm-summary-default.notes: Baseline 2. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY. Non-trainable — no PPO weights.
